profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
I graduated from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute with a Bachelor's of Science in Computer Science. I am currently looking for Entry Level Software Engineering positions that will allow me to translate skills from personal projects and volunteering. 

I am certified with a CompTIA Security+ for developing secure applications and have the skills to excel in both a Fullstack or DevOps position:

  - CyberSec Skills: I have experience in penetration testing on both the Red Team and Blue team. I've used Wireshark, Sleuthkit and Metasploit to monitor network traffic and identify vulnerabilities in software applications.

  - FullStack Skills: I have experience working with object-oriented languages, such as C++, C#, Java, and Python, as well as web technologies, such as CSS, HTML, and Javascript. I am familiar with the Django and Flask frameworks, as well as ReactJS` for UI.

  - DevOps Skills: I have deployed docker-containerized applications as an Azure hosted service. I have experience with Elasticsearch, and Splunk so I can develop essential monitoring tools and CI/CD pipelines to manage services.

I am currently volunteering at local San Jose libraries as a Library Service Volunteer, a Girls Who Code Club Facilitator, and Ukulele Assistant. As a Library Service Volunteer, I ensure the library is a welcoming place for people of all ages and backgrounds to visit through maintaining the available media, tidying communal areas, and assisting with library-run programs. As a Girls Who Code Facilitator, I help teach 6th-12th grade students fundamental coding concepts and inspire them to explore STEM fields. As a Ukulele Assistant, I assist beginning ukulele students with basic ukulele skills, such as tuning, finger patterns, and strumming.

projects.title: PanThemon
projects.description: Developing an interactive experience with a React-and Flask-based web application generating Pokemon-themed eyeshadow combinations utilizing images from the user’s makeup collection. Creating a React-based UI that communicates with Flask server through RESTful API to analyze palette images using image processing techniques and OpenCV and deciding which algorithm to use while adding manual user input to define what is usable from the image.

projects.title: Beauty Ingredient Scrapper
projects.description:
Building a React- and Flask-based web application that analyzes skincare ingredients
information to allow consumers to easily learn more about their skincare products
in order to easily make more conscious decisions when choosing products.
